# Kenney Audio

Recorded sound effects used by TRip were selected from these Kenney packs:

- Interface Sounds: UI feedback (`ui/`)
- RPG Audio: leather, cloth and book foley (`ui/`, `foley/`)
- Impact Sounds: grass footsteps, landing and metamorphosis impacts (`foley/`, `metamorphosis/`)

Author: Kenney — https://kenney.nl/

License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0 Universal).

Source pages:

- https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds
- https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio
- https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds

Downloaded on 2026-08-21. File names are preserved where practical; renamed files only describe their in-game use.
